exposure: Including only centers offering fetal monitoring at 23 weeks and excluding antepartum stillbirths
outcome: Neonatal morbidity (severe brain injury, retinopathy of prematurity)
cohort: 248 women and 287 infants delivered at 23+0 to 23+6 weeks' gestation
finding: Pregnant women delivering at 23 weeks' gestation experience high rates of maternal complications, and their infants have high rates of mortality and serious morbidity.
mod_finding: This study found that Cesarean section rates for women delivering at 23 weeks' gestation were 10.5%.
